CommunityApplications.Profile: TimeTracker is a self-hosted time tracking, project management, and Peppol e-invoicing app (GPL-3.0). Install TimeTracker-DB first, then TimeTracker on the same timetracker network. Set SECRET_KEY with openssl rand -hex 32. Support: https://github.com/DRYTRIX/TimeTracker/issues — Docs: https://github.com/DRYTRIX/TimeTracker/blob/main/docs/admin/deployment/DISTRIBUTION.md
